speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Thank you all for being here today.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: It is a great honour to address this chamber.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Unemployment has fallen to 3.8 percent, the lowest in a decade.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Our GDP grew by

speaker: SPEAKER_00

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: We have added 450,000 jobs in the manufacturing sector since 2021.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: I want to be very clear about what we stand for.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Every child in this country deserves a quality education.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: We have invested $4.2 billion in public schools over the past three years.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Test scores have risen by 12 points on average since our reforms began.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: What kind of future do we want for our children?

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Infant mortality has dropped by 18 percent since 2019.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Let me turn now to the economy.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Inflation is down to 2.4 percent, below the OECD average of 3.1 percent.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: I met a nurse last week who told me she finally feels secure.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Healthcare spending per capita is now $3,800, up from $3,100 in 2020.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: We believe everyone deserves access to affordable housing.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: We built 120,000 new affordable units last year, more than any U.S. state.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: These are real achievements.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: With respect, the government's record is far less impressive.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: In reality, real wages have fallen by 4.7 percent over the same period.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: Food bank usage has tripled since 2021, reaching a record 2.3 million visits.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: That is not the record of a government that cares about working people.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: NHS waiting lists stand at a record high of 7.6 million patients.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: I could go on, but time does not permit.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: Carbon emissions rose by 2.9 percent last year, reversing a decade of progress.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: We owe it to future generations to do better.

text: Our renewable energy capacity has doubled. Solar installations grew by 34 percent.

text: Violent crime is down 15 percent compared with five years ago.
